draft_notice.what: pre-registration DRAFT for the independent-information (data-window) probe; it is not registered, carries no registration timestamp and licenses nothing
draft_notice.may_be_registered_only_by: the captain, after user approval and machine confirmation
draft_notice.registration_instruction: 等待用户批准 + 机器确认后由队长指示注册；本文件在注册前不得被引用为预登记，也不得据此开跑任何训练

rulings.why: it is the user's original 132-day caliber and it is 2.2x the 60-day window rather than 2.0x, so it separates the data effect from the noise scale more sharply
rulings.note: the 120-day alternative stays in alternatives_measured for the record only and is not to be discussed again

rulings.ruling: screening caliber, not promotion caliber: level 1 escalates to level 2 only on the v2 still_improving state - point estimate >= 0.0017 AND 5-day block interval lower bound > 0 AND at least 4 of 5 declared periods positive
rulings.why: 0.0017 on its own is below the measured seed noise, so the interval condition is load-bearing, not decoration
rulings.separation: promotion still requires min_improvement 0.0034 plus a three-seed aggregate; the two decisions are written separately and may not be conflated

rulings.ruling: the driver re-derives usable samples and steps at run time; the registered text carries an estimate only and must label it estimate_not_budget; registration must record a +/-5% deviation tolerance, and a run whose realised usable samples or steps fall outside that tolerance must stop and report instead of continuing silently

rulings.topic: training memory for the enlarged pool
rulings.ruling: measure it on the cloud before the formal trajectory: run 200-500 steps with the same configuration, sample peak RSS and persist the measurement; if it exceeds the host capacity, abort and report - no 'just try it'
rulings.wording: the 24 GiB line constrains the inference/submission path only; training-host capacity is a separate question and must be stated as such

rulings.ruling: level 2 needs its own pre-registration; level 1 does not authorize level 2
level 1 uses the existing 60-day replays as controls and does not re-run the control
keep them marked superseded_by: t22 and give no budget commitment until t22 lands

ratified_design.kept: motivation.honest_bound is kept as written: only the 5.28 point is a determined overfit, 1.32 and 2.64 are intermediate, so this probe tests whether the whole in-sample/out-of-sample gap curve shifts, not whether one determined-overfit point can be rescued

motivation.source: t21 upper-bound probe (runs/training-in-sample-probe-20261027/, plan sha d03e00f8…) relayed by the captain
motivation.reading: in-sample RankIC rises monotonically with the budget and the in-sample budget-point differences exclude zero (5.28-2.64 +0.06384 [0.04622, 0.08543]), so the recipe can fit the training window; out-of-sample falls monotonically, so the binding constraint is independent information rather than capacity or optimization
motivation.honest_bound: only the 5.28 point is a determined overfit; 1.32 and 2.64 are intermediate/inconclusive. This probe runs where the regime is intermediate and tests whether the whole in-sample/out-of-sample gap curve shifts, not whether one determined-overfit point can be rescued
motivation.why_a_data_window_and_not_more_training: t5 measured all three budget points on the 60-day window: every additional doubling lowered the out-of-sample primary metric with an interval entirely below zero, and decision rule v2 refuses further training amount

single_factor: the size of the training window only (how many trading days of history feed the same recipe); the trunk, features, labels, loss, sampling, learning-rate rule, budget points and evaluation window stay frozen

ladder.train_window_rule: 132 trading days ending 2023-10-31 inclusive; the training window never reaches the validation split
ladder.reference_config_note: the 120-day config window (2023-05-05..2023-10-31) is exactly 120 trading days; it is kept only as a recorded alternative, the ratified window is 132

ladder.trigger: level 1 reaches the ratified escalation state
ladder.authorization: level 1 does not authorize level 2; level 2 requires its own pre-registration and its own approval

escalation_rule.rule: level 1 -> level 2 only if all three hold: paired improvement >= 0.0017; 5-day block interval lower bound > 0; at least 4 of the 5 declared periods positive
escalation_rule.is: the v2 state still_improving, i.e. the screening caliber
escalation_rule.why_the_interval_is_load_bearing: 0.0017 alone sits below the measured noise: the registered placebo scale is 0.003305 and the measured seed-dispersion medians are 0.00241-0.00312, so a point estimate at the floor is not distinguishable from noise without the interval condition
escalation_rule.not_the_promotion_caliber: promotion separately requires min_improvement 0.0034 with the same interval and repeat conditions plus a three-seed aggregate; escalation to level 2 must never be reported as a promotion step

applies_to_comparison.why: C1 isolates the training-window size at the anchor budget, which is exactly the factor this probe changes; C2 would mix the window change with the budget sweep

budget_only_overrides.model.max_steps: cleared; the pre-registered trajectory steps govern the budget
budget_only_overrides.model.epochs: kept as an upper bound above the last budget point
budget_only_overrides.data.splits.train.start: moved earlier to 2023-04-14; this is the single changed factor
budget_only_overrides.note: any other deviation from configs/mlplob_v3_60d_csz_19800.json must fail the run guard

steps_and_cost.do_not_hardcode: the step time and the window stay provisional until the t22 profiling conclusion lands; nothing here may be pasted into a registered document unchanged

deviation_tolerance.rule: the registration must record this tolerance; a run whose realised usable samples or steps deviate beyond +/-5% from the estimate stops and reports, it does not continue silently

usable_sample_estimate.method: usable_samples scale with the number of trading days at a fixed 8 sample times and universe

validated_at_60_days.note: the scaling reproduces the measured 19,777 steps exactly, so it is a calibrated estimate and still only an estimate

step_time.source: t4 cloud run: 3002.56 s wall over 79,106 steps (runs/training-trajectory-20261027/20261027T124332.686678Z_d2da968fc909 manifest resources.wall_seconds)
step_time.superseded_by: t22 training-step profile (in progress); the registered cost estimate must be recomputed from t22
step_time.note: reproduces the captain's ~55 min figure; it is not a budget commitment and no wall-clock promise may be registered before t22

pre_flight_required.when: before the formal trajectory, on the cloud host, with the same 132-day configuration
pre_flight_required.what: run 200-500 optimizer steps, sample peak RSS at a fixed interval, persist the measurement with the run artifacts
pre_flight_required.gate: if peak RSS approaches or exceeds the host capacity, abort and report; starting the formal run to see what happens is prohibited
pre_flight_required.existing_accounting: the 60-day window tensors accounted for 2.95 GB of a 19,584 MB archived peak; the 132-day pool is about 2.2x, and the validation-phase tensorization dominated that peak rather than the training pool
pre_flight_required.caliber_note: the 24 GiB pre-registered line constrains the inference/submission path only; this is a training-host capacity measurement and is reported, not gated by that line

controls.rule: the control for every level-1 arm is the 60-day arm at the same budget point, evaluated on the identical declared months with the identical estimator

comparisons.question: does a longer training window help at the same budget, with no extra training
does the point where extra training stops paying move right when the sample grows
comparisons.isolates: training-window size only, at the second budget point

comparisons.question: with more independent information, does a further doubling still pay
comparisons.isolates: budget only, inside the enlarged window

interval.method: consecutive trading-day blocks inside each declared period, never crossing a gap

decision.secondary_and_net5: reported alongside and compared against the registered secondary lines and the net5 limit; 5bp stays a locked stress gate and is never a positive promotion condition
decision.promotion: this probe screens; promotion still needs scripts/promotion_gate.py under min_improvement 0.0034 against the incumbent baseline, and a three-seed aggregate

evaluation.why_these: the five declared research months of the registered b4 pre-registration; the enlarged training window ends 2023-10-31 so every evaluated day stays out of sample

boundaries.single_seed: screening only; any candidate that must pass the gate has to be completed to the three seeds of the baseline family

open_items_before_registration: pin which comparison drives the escalation rule: C1 (pure data effect at the anchor budget) is proposed because it isolates the window change; C2 would mix the window with the budget sweep. The registered text must name one
re-pin the step time from the t22 training-step profile and recompute the cost estimate; the 37.96 ms/step figure is the t4 observation, not a promise
record the +/-5% usable-sample and step deviation tolerance in the registered document and wire the stop-and-report rule into the run pre-flight
attach the training-memory pre-flight measurement plan (200-500 steps, peak RSS, abort rule) as a required execution step of the registered document
the registration action itself: user approval plus machine confirmation, then the captain instructs the registration
prohibitions: no registration, no training and no probe run from this draft
no hardcoding of the step time, the wall-clock budget or the exact window before t22 and the captain's approval
no silent continuation when realised usable samples or steps deviate beyond the recorded tolerance
no run-it-and-see on the enlarged pool: the memory pre-flight runs first and can abort the plan
no starting level 2 under level 1's registration
no change to any promotion threshold, secondary line, net5 limit, evidence rule or period declaration
no reading of the sealed interval, at any level
no claim that more training helps: the budget direction was refused in t5 and this probe tests data, not budget
no reporting of a single-seed arm as a candidate; the gate needs a three-seed aggregate
no relaxation of the 5bp stress scenario and no treatment of a cost-scenario result as a primary-metric result
